rootRule: Weather Mother opens World by default and preserves the accepted v110-full runtime.
navigationRule: The UI is closed by default. A compact WM button opens a Liquid Glass hierarchy: Weather Mother > Rain > Liquid Rain > control section.
mobileRule: No persistent top strip. The closed state occupies only a 44 px launcher plus safe-area inset.
rainRule: Liquid Rain V1.3 is a child module with rich controls for rain, cloud source, ground water, glass optics, materials and view.
otherModuleRule: Fog, Snow, Cloud and Storm use existing v110-full cases until the user explicitly requests targeted development.
deliveryRule: Return one verified direct public workbench URL in routine delivery. Do not send packages, attachments, screenshots, hashes or QA prose unless explicitly requested.
